units.zh: 〈（案：《薛史·晉后妃傳》，《永樂大典》已佚，今采《五代會要》、《通鑒》、《契丹國志》、《文獻通考》所載晉后妃事，分註以補是書之闕。）〉
units.en: (Note: The Biographies of Later Jin Empresses and Consorts in Xue's History, lost from the Yongle Encyclopedia, are here supplemented from empress and consort accounts in the Five Dynasties Essentials, Comprehensive Mirror, Khitan State Annals, and Comprehensive Examination of Documents, set out in separate notes.)〉
units.literal: (Note: The 《Biographies of Later Jin Empresses and Consorts》 in the 《History of Xue》, lost from the 《Yongle Encyclopedia》, now gathers Later Jin empress and consort matters recorded in the 《Five Dynasties Essentials》, 《Comprehensive Mirror》, 《Khitan State Annals》, and 《Comprehensive Examination of Documents》, set out in separate notes to fill this book's lacunae.)〉

units.zh: 高祖皇后李氏。
units.en: Empress Li of Gaozu.
units.literal: Empress Li of Gaozu.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：高祖皇后李氏，唐明宗第三女。
units.en: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials: Empress Li of Gaozu was the third daughter of Mingzong of Tang.
units.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Empress Li of Gaozu was Mingzong of Tang's third daughter.

units.zh: 天成三年四月，封永寧公主；
units.en: In the fourth month of Tiancheng 3 she was enfeoffed as Princess of Yongning;
units.literal: In the fourth month of Tiancheng 3, she was enfeoffed as Princess of Yongning;

units.zh: 長興四年九月，進封魏國公主；
units.en: In the ninth month of Changxing 4 she was advanced to Princess of Wei;
units.literal: In the ninth month of Changxing 4, she was advanced to Princess of Wei;

units.zh: 清泰二年九月，改封晉國長公主；
units.en: In the ninth month of Qingtai 2 she was restyled Senior Princess of Jin;
units.literal: In the ninth month of Qingtai 2, she was changed to Princess of Jin;

units.zh: 至天福六年十一月，尊為皇后；
units.en: By the eleventh month of Tianfu 6 she was honored as empress;
units.literal: By the eleventh month of Tianfu 6, she was honored as empress;

units.zh: 七年六月，尊為皇太后。
units.en: In the sixth month of the seventh year she was honored as empress dowager.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, she was honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 開運四年三月，與少帝同遷於契丹之黃龍府。
units.en: In the third month of Kaiyun 4 she was relocated with the Young Emperor to the Khitan seat at Yellow Dragon Prefecture.
units.literal: In the third month of Kaiyun 4, she was moved together with the Young Emperor to the Khitan Yellow Dragon Prefecture.

units.zh: 漢乾祐三年八月二十五日，崩於蕃中之建丘。
units.en: On the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month of Qianyou 3 of Han she died at Jianqiu in the Khitan territories.
units.literal: On the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month of Qianyou 3 of Han, she died at Jianqiu in the barbarian lands.

units.zh: 《文獻通考》云：天福二年，有司請立皇后，帝以宗廟未立，謙抑未遑。
units.en: The Comprehensive Examination of Documents records that in Tianfu 2 the officials asked that an empress be installed, but the emperor, because the ancestral temple had not yet been established, modestly put the matter aside.
units.literal: The 《Comprehensive Examination of Documents》 says: In Tianfu 2, the officials requested that an empress be installed; the emperor, because the ancestral temple had not yet been established, modestly deferred and had no leisure for it.

units.zh: 帝崩，出帝即位，乃尊為皇太后。
units.en: Only after the emperor's death, when the Deposed Emperor took the throne, was she honored as empress dowager.
units.literal: When the emperor died and the Deposed Emperor acceded, only then was she honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 《契丹國志》載晉出帝降表云：「晉室皇太后媳婦李氏妾言：張彥澤、傅住兒等至，伏蒙皇帝阿翁降書安撫者。
units.en: The Khitan State Annals preserves the Deposed Emperor of Jin's surrender memorial, which reads: "The daughter-in-law of the Jin imperial house, Empress Dowager Lady Li, your handmaid, says: When Zhang Yanze, Fu Zhu'er, and the others arrived, I prostrated myself and received Your Majesty the Emperor and Grandfather's gracious letter of reassurance.
units.literal: The 《Khitan State Annals》 records the surrender memorial of the Deposed Emperor of Jin, which says: "The daughter-in-law of the Jin imperial household, empress dowager Lady Li, your handmaid, says: When Zhang Yanze, Fu Zhu'er, and the others arrived, I prostrated myself and received Your Majesty the Emperor and Grandfather's descending letter of reassurance.

units.zh: 妾伏念先皇帝頃在並、汾，適逢屯難，危同累卵，急若倒懸，智勇俱窮，朝夕不保。
units.en: Your handmaid humbly recalls that when the late emperor was at Bing and Fen, he suddenly met with encirclement and disaster; danger was as fragile as a pile of eggs, urgency as desperate as a man hung upside down; wisdom and courage were both spent, and from morning to evening he could not be preserved.
units.literal: Your handmaid humbly recalls that when the late emperor was recently at Bing and Fen, he suddenly met with encirclement and hardship; danger was like a pile of eggs; urgency was like a man hung upside down; wisdom and courage were both exhausted; morning and evening he could not be preserved.

units.zh: 皇帝阿翁發自冀北，親抵河東，跋履山川，逾越險阻，立平巨孽，遂定中原。
units.en: Your Majesty the Emperor and Grandfather set out from north of Ji, came in person to Hedong, tramped through mountains and rivers and crossed perilous passes, swiftly pacified the great rebel, and thus settled the Central Plain.
units.literal: Your Majesty the Emperor and Grandfather set out from north of Ji, personally reached Hedong, trampled through mountains and rivers, crossed dangerous barriers, quickly pacified the great rebel, and thus settled the Central Plain.

units.zh: 救石氏之覆亡，立晉朝之社稷。
units.en: He rescued the Shi clan from ruin and restored the altars of the Jin dynasty.
units.literal: He rescued the Shi clan from overthrow and established the altars of the Jin court.

units.zh: 不幸先帝厭代，嗣子承祧，不能繼好息民，而反虧恩辜義，兵戈屢動，駟馬難追，戚實自貽，咎將誰執。
units.en: Unfortunately the late emperor passed away; the heir received the ancestral line yet could not continue friendship and give the people rest, but instead violated kindness and betrayed righteousness; war was raised again and again, and what four horses could not overtake was truly sorrow of our own making — upon whom shall the blame fall?
units.literal: Unfortunately the late emperor passed from the world; the heir received the ancestral line; he could not continue friendship and rest the people, but on the contrary violated kindness and betrayed righteousness; war was raised repeatedly; four horses could not be recalled; the sorrow was truly self-inflicted — upon whom shall the blame be laid?

units.zh: 今穹旻震怒，中外攜離，上將牽羊，六師解甲。
units.en: Now Heaven above is enraged, the court and the realm are torn apart, the sovereign above will lead the sheep in surrender, and the six armies have laid down their arms.
units.literal: Now Heaven above is angry; inside and outside are divided; the emperor above will lead the sheep; the six armies lay down their armor.

units.zh: 妾舉宗負釁，視景偷生。
units.en: Your handmaid, with the whole clan bearing guilt, clings to life while watching our own shadows.
units.literal: Your handmaid, with the whole clan, bears punishment; looking at our shadow, we steal life.

units.zh: 惶惑之中，撫問斯至，明宣恩旨，曲賜含容，慰諭丁寧，神爽飛越。
units.en: Amid bewilderment your inquiry arrived; your gracious edict was clearly proclaimed; you bent favor to grant forbearance and repeated your comfort and instruction with such care that my spirit soared in exultation.
units.literal: In bewilderment, your inquiry arrived; your gracious edict was clearly proclaimed; favor was bent to grant forbearance; comfort and instruction were repeated with care; the spirit soared in exultation.

units.zh: 豈謂已垂之命，忽蒙更生之恩，省罪責躬，九死未報。
units.en: Who would have thought that a life already hanging by a thread would suddenly receive the grace of rebirth? Reflecting on my guilt and blaming myself, even nine deaths would not repay it.
units.literal: Who would have thought that a life already hanging would suddenly receive the grace of rebirth? Reflecting on guilt and blaming myself, nine deaths would not repay it.

units.zh: 今遣孫男延煦、延寶奉表請罪，陳謝以聞。」
units.en: Now I send my grandsons Yanxu and Yanbao to present this memorial begging forgiveness and to declare my apology for your hearing."
units.literal: Now I send my grandsons Yanxu and Yanbao to present this memorial begging forgiveness, to declare my apology and report it."

units.zh: 又，《帝紀》云：會同十一年正月朔，出帝、太后迎遼帝於封丘門外，帝辭不見，館於封禪寺，遣其將崔廷勛以兵守之。
units.en: The Imperial Annals also records that on the new moon of the first month in the eleventh year of Tonghui, the Deposed Emperor and the empress dowager welcomed the Liao emperor outside the Fengqiu Gate; the emperor declined to see them, lodged them at the Fengchan Temple, and dispatched his general Cui Tingxun with troops to guard them.
units.literal: Also, the 《Imperial Annals》 says: On the first day of the first month of the eleventh year of Tonghui, the Deposed Emperor and the empress dowager welcomed the Liao emperor outside the Fengqiu Gate; the emperor declined to see them and lodged them at the Fengchan Temple, dispatching his general Cui Tingxun with troops to guard them.

units.zh: 是時雨雪連旬，外無供億，上下凍餒。
units.en: At that time snow and rain lasted ten days in succession; there were no supplies from outside, and those above and below were freezing and starving.
units.literal: At that time snow and rain continued for ten days; outside there were no supplies; above and below were freezing and starving.

units.zh: 太后使人謂寺僧曰：「吾嘗於此飯僧數萬，今日豈不相憫耶？」
units.en: The empress dowager sent someone to tell the temple monks: "I once fed tens of thousands of monks here — are you not moved to pity us today?"
units.literal: The empress dowager sent someone to tell the temple monks: "I once fed tens of thousands of monks here — today are you not moved to pity?"

units.zh: 僧辭以遼帝之意難測，不敢獻食。
units.en: The monks refused, citing the unpredictable mood of the Liao emperor, and dared not provide food.
units.literal: The monks declined, citing the Liao emperor's unpredictable intent, and dared not present food.

units.zh: 少帝陰祈守者，乃稍得食。
units.en: The Young Emperor secretly appealed to the guards, and so they were gradually able to get food.
units.literal: The Young Emperor secretly prayed to the guards, and only then were they gradually able to obtain food.

units.zh: 遼降少帝為光祿大夫，檢校太尉，封負義侯，遷於黃龍府，即慕容氏和龍城也。
units.en: The Liao demoted the Young Emperor to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Inspector-General Grand Marshal, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Unrighteousness, and relocated him to Yellow Dragon Prefecture — the Murong clan's Helong City.
units.literal: The Liao demoted the Young Emperor to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, made him Inspector-General Grand Marshal, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Unrighteousness, and moved him to Yellow Dragon Prefecture — that is, the Murong clan's Helong City.

units.zh: 帝使人謂太后曰：「吾聞爾子重貴，不從母教而至於此，可求自便，勿與俱行。」
units.en: The emperor sent someone to tell the empress dowager: "I hear your son Chonggui did not heed his mother's teaching and came to this — you may seek your own convenience; do not travel with him."
units.literal: The emperor sent someone to tell the empress dowager: "I hear your son Chonggui did not obey his mother's teaching and came to this — you may seek your own convenience; do not travel together with him."

units.zh: 太后答曰：「重貴事妾謹慎，所失者違先君之志，絕兩國之歡。
units.en: The empress dowager replied: "Chonggui has served me with care; what was lost was going against the late sovereign's will and severing friendship between our two states.
units.literal: The empress dowager replied: "Chonggui has been careful toward me in his service; what was lost was going against the late lord's will and severing friendship between the two states.

units.zh: 然重貴此去，幸蒙大惠，全身保家，母不隨子，欲何所歸？」
units.en: Yet if Chonggui goes hence, fortunately receiving great kindness and preserving body and house — if a mother does not follow her son, whither would she go?"
units.literal: Yet if Chonggui goes hence, fortunately receiving great kindness, preserving body and house — if a mother does not follow her son, whither would she go?"

units.zh: 於是太后與馮氏、皇弟重睿。
units.en: Thereupon the empress dowager, Lady Feng, and the emperor's younger brother Chongrui
units.literal: Thereupon the empress dowager, together with Lady Feng and the emperor's younger brother Chongrui

units.zh: 子延煦延寶，舉族從晉侯而北。
units.en: together with the sons Yanxu and Yanbao, the whole clan followed the Marquis of Jin northward.
units.literal: along with her sons Yanxu and Yanbao, the whole clan followed the Marquis of Jin northward.

units.zh: 天祿元年四月，帝至遼陽，晉侯白衣紗帽與太后、皇后上謁於帳中。
units.en: In the fourth month of the first year of Tianlu the emperor reached Liaoyang; the Marquis of Jin, in white robes and gauze cap, together with the empress dowager and empress, paid homage inside the tent.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Tianlu, the emperor reached Liaoyang; the Marquis of Jin, in white robes and gauze cap, together with the empress dowager and empress, paid homage inside the tent.

units.zh: 五月，帝上陘，取晉侯所從宦者十五人、東西班十五人及皇子延煦而去。
units.en: In the fifth month, as the emperor ascended the pass, he took fifteen of the Marquis of Jin's attendants, fifteen men from the eastern and western shifts, and the imperial son Yanxu.
units.literal: In the fifth month, as the emperor ascended the pass, he took fifteen of the attendants who followed the Marquis of Jin, fifteen men from the eastern and western shifts, and the imperial son Yanxu, and departed.

units.zh: 八月，帝下陘，太后自馳至霸州謁帝，求於漢兒城側賜地耕牧以為生。
units.en: In the eighth month, as the emperor descended the pass, the empress dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to pay homage, asking for land beside Hanz Er City to farm and herd for a living.
units.literal: In the eighth month, as the emperor descended the pass, the empress dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to pay homage, asking that land beside Hanz Er City be granted to farm and herd for a living.

units.zh: 許之。
units.en: Permission was granted.
units.literal: He granted it.

units.zh: 帝以太后自行十餘日，遣與延煦俱還遼陽。
units.en: After the empress dowager had traveled on her own for more than ten days, the emperor sent her back to Liaoyang with Yanxu.
units.literal: Because the empress dowager had traveled on her own for more than ten days, the emperor sent her back to Liaoyang together with Yanxu.

units.zh: 二年，徙晉侯、太后於建州。
units.en: In the second year, the Marquis of Jin and the empress dowager were relocated to Jianzhou.
units.literal: In the second year, the Marquis of Jin and the empress dowager were moved to Jianzhou.

units.zh: 三年秋八月，晉李太后病，無醫藥，仰天號泣，戟手罵杜重威、李守貞曰：「吾死不置汝。」
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn of the third year Empress Li of Jin fell ill; there were no medicines; she wept to Heaven and, pointing with her hand, cursed Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen, saying: "When I die I will not let you go."
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn of the third year, Empress Li of Jin fell ill; there were no medicine or drugs; she wept to Heaven and, pointing with her hand, cursed Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen, saying: "When I die I will not leave you in peace."

units.zh: 病亟，謂晉侯曰：「吾死，焚其骨送范陽佛寺，無使吾為邊地鬼也。」）〉
units.en: As her illness became critical, she told the Marquis of Jin: "When I die, burn my bones and send them to a Buddhist monastery in Fanyang — do not let me become a ghost of the borderlands." )〉
units.literal: As her illness became critical, she told the Marquis of Jin: "When I die, burn my bones and send them to a Buddhist monastery in Fanyang — do not let me become a ghost of the borderlands." )〉

units.zh: 太妃安氏。
units.en: Grand Consort An.
units.literal: Grand Consort An.

units.zh: 〈（《文獻通考》：安太妃，代北人，不知其世家。
units.en: (From the Comprehensive Examination of Documents: Grand Consort An was a native of northern Dai; her family background is unknown.
units.literal: (The 《Comprehensive Examination of Documents》: Grand Consort An was a native of northern Dai; her lineage is unknown.

units.zh: 生出帝，帝立，尊為皇太妃。
units.en: She bore the Deposed Emperor; when he took the throne, she was honored as Grand Imperial Consort.
units.literal: She bore the Deposed Emperor; when he was enthroned, she was honored as Grand Imperial Consort.

units.zh: 《契丹國志》云：天祿二年春二月，徙晉侯、太后於建州，中途安太妃卒，遺命晉侯曰：「焚骨為灰，南向揚之，庶幾遺魂得返中國也。」）〉
units.en: The Khitan State Annals records that in the second month of spring of the second year of Tianlu, when the Marquis of Jin and the empress dowager were relocated to Jianzhou, Grand Consort An died en route; her dying charge to the Marquis of Jin was: "Burn my bones to ash and scatter them southward — perhaps my lingering soul may return to China.")〉
units.literal: The 《Khitan State Annals》 says: In the second month of spring of the second year of Tianlu, when the Marquis of Jin and the empress dowager were moved to Jianzhou, Grand Consort An died en route; her dying charge to the Marquis of Jin was: "Burn my bones to ash and scatter them southward — perhaps my lingering soul may return to China.")〉

units.zh: 少帝皇后張氏。
units.en: Empress Zhang of the Young Emperor.
units.literal: Empress Zhang of the Young Emperor.

units.zh: 〈（案《五代會要》：天福八年十月追冊。
units.en: (Note: According to the Five Dynasties Essentials, posthumous investiture came in the tenth month of Tianfu 8.
units.literal: (Note: The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: In the tenth month of Tianfu 8, posthumous investiture.

units.zh: 考薛史《少帝紀》云：追冊故妃張氏為皇后。
units.en: According to Xue's History, Annals of the Young Emperor, the late consort Lady Zhang was posthumously invested as empress.
units.literal: Examining Xue's History, 《Annals of the Young Emperor》, it says: posthumously invested the late consort Lady Zhang as empress.

units.zh: 《張從訓傳》亦云，高祖鎮太原，為少帝娶從訓長女為妃。）〉
units.en: The Biography of Zhang Congxun also records that when Gaozu was posted at Taiyuan, he took Congxun's eldest daughter as consort for the Young Emperor.)〉
units.literal: The 《Biography of Zhang Congxun》 also says: when Gaozu was posted at Taiyuan, he took Congxun's eldest daughter as consort for the Young Emperor.)〉

units.zh: 皇后馮氏。
units.en: Empress Feng.
units.literal: Empress Feng.

units.zh: 〈（案《五代會要》：開運三年十月冊。
units.en: (Note: According to the Five Dynasties Essentials, investiture took place in the tenth month of Kaiyun 3.
units.literal: (Note: The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Investiture in the tenth month of Kaiyun 3.

units.zh: 《通鑒》云：天福八年冬十月戊申，立吳國夫人馮氏為皇后。
units.en: The Comprehensive Mirror records that on wushen of the tenth month of winter in Tianfu 8, Lady Feng, Madame of Wu, was installed as empress.
units.literal: The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 says: On wushen of the tenth month of winter in Tianfu 8, Lady Feng, Madame of Wu, was installed as empress.

units.zh: 初，高祖愛少弟重胤，養以為子。
units.en: At first Gaozu loved his youngest brother Chongyin and raised him as his own son.
units.literal: At first Gaozu loved his youngest brother Chongyin and raised him as a son.

units.zh: 及留守鄴都，娶副留守馮濛女為其婦，重胤早卒，馮夫人寡居，有美色，帝見而悅之。
units.en: When he was left to garrison Yedu, he took the daughter of Vice Resident Feng Meng as wife for him; Chongyin died early; Madame Feng lived as a widow and was beautiful; the emperor saw her and was pleased with her.
units.literal: When he was left to garrison Yedu, he took the daughter of Vice Resident Feng Meng as wife for him; Chongyin died early; Madame Feng lived as a widow; she had beautiful looks; the emperor saw her and was pleased with her.

units.zh: 高祖崩，梓宮在殯，帝遂納之。
units.en: While Gaozu's coffin still lay in state, the emperor took her as his consort.
units.literal: When Gaozu died, while the coffin still lay in state, the emperor took her in.

units.zh: 群臣皆賀，帝謂馮道等曰：「皇太后之命，與卿等不任大慶。」
units.en: All the officials congratulated him; the emperor said to Feng Dao and the others: "By the empress dowager's command, you cannot bear the burden of grand celebration either."
units.literal: All the officials congratulated him; the emperor said to Feng Dao and the others: "By the empress dowager's command, you and the others cannot bear the burden of grand celebration."

units.zh: 群臣出，帝與夫人酣飲，過梓宮前，叕而告曰：「皇太后之命，與先帝不任大慶。」
units.en: When the officials had gone out, the emperor drank heavily with the lady. Passing before the imperial coffin, he bowed twice and announced: "By the empress dowager's command, my late father cannot bear the burden of grand celebration either."
units.literal: When the officials had gone out, the emperor drank heavily with the lady; passing before the imperial coffin, he bowed twice and announced: "By the empress dowager's command, my late father cannot bear the burden of grand celebration either."

units.zh: 左右失笑，帝亦自笑，謂左右曰：「我今日作新婿何如？」
units.en: Those beside him could not hold back laughter; the emperor laughed too and asked those around him: "How do I look as a new bridegroom today?"
units.literal: Those beside him could not hold back laughter; the emperor laughed too and asked those around him: "How do I look as a new bridegroom today?"

units.zh: 夫人與左右皆大笑。
units.en: The lady and those beside him all laughed heartily.
units.literal: The lady and those beside him all laughed greatly.

units.zh: 太后雖恚，而無如之何。
units.en: The empress dowager, though resentful, could do nothing about it.
units.literal: The empress dowager, though resentful, could do nothing about it.

units.zh: 既正位中宮，頗預政事。
units.en: Once established in the central palace, she took a considerable part in government affairs.
units.literal: Once she was established in the central palace, she took part in government affairs to a considerable degree.

units.zh: 後兄玉，時為禮部郎中、鹽鐵判官，帝驟擢用至端明殿學士、戶部侍郎，與議政事。
units.en: Her elder brother Yu, then a director in the Ministry of Rites and salt and iron commissioner, was suddenly promoted to Academician of the Hall of Duanming and Vice Minister of Revenue and given a voice in government affairs.
units.literal: Her elder brother Yu, then a director in the Ministry of Rites and salt and iron commissioner, was suddenly promoted to Academician of the Hall of Duanming and Vice Minister of Revenue and given a voice in government affairs.

units.zh: 《文獻通考》云：契丹入京師，後隨帝北遷，不知所終。
units.en: The Comprehensive Examination of Documents records that when the Khitan entered the capital, the empress followed the emperor northward; her end is unknown.
units.literal: The 《Comprehensive Examination of Documents》 says: When the Khitan entered the capital, the empress followed the emperor northward; her end is unknown.

units.zh: 又，案《五代會要》載晉內職云：高祖潁川郡夫人蔡氏，天福三年八月敕。
units.en: Also, (Note: The Five Dynasties Essentials records Jin inner offices: Lady Cai, Madame of Yingchuan Commandery — by edict of the eighth month of Tianfu 3.
units.literal: Also, (Note: The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records Jin inner offices: Lady Cai, Madame of Yingchuan Commandery — edict of the eighth month of Tianfu 3.

units.zh: 少帝寶省李氏封隴西郡夫人；
units.en: Lady Li of the Young Emperor's Baosheng Palace was enfeoffed as Madame of Longxi Commandery;
units.literal: Lady Li of the Young Emperor's Baosheng Palace was enfeoffed as Madame of Longxi Commandery;

units.zh: 張氏封春宮夫人，充皇后宮尚宮，並天福八年十二月二日敕。
units.en: Lady Zhang was enfeoffed as Madame of the Spring Palace and appointed Chief Palace Officer of the empress's palace — both by edict of the second day of the twelfth month of Tianfu 8.
units.literal: Lady Zhang was enfeoffed as Madame of the Spring Palace, serving as Chief Palace Officer of the empress's palace — both by edict of the second day of the twelfth month of Tianfu 8.

units.zh: 前左禦正齊國夫人吳氏進封燕國夫人，書省魏國夫人崔氏進封梁國夫人，前右禦正天水郡夫人趙氏封衛國夫人，司簿孟氏封汧國夫人，前司簿李氏封隴西郡夫人，弟子院使齊氏、大使郭氏、副使賈氏並封本縣君，太后宮尚宮陳留郡夫人何氏進封鄭國夫人，河南郡夫人元氏進封齊國夫人，知客出使夫人石氏封武威郡夫人，春宮姚氏、常氏、焦氏、王氏、陶氏、魏氏、趙氏七人並超封郡夫人，寶省婉美趙氏封天水郡夫人，武氏以下十一人並授春宮，天福八年十一月敕。
units.en: Former Left Imperial Rectifier Madame Wu of Qi was advanced to Madame of Yan; Secretariat Madame Cui of Wei was advanced to Madame of Liang; Former Right Imperial Rectifier Madame Zhao of Tianshui Commandery was enfeoffed Madame of Wei; Registrar Madame Meng was enfeoffed Madame of Qian; Former Registrar Madame Li was enfeoffed Madame of Longxi Commandery; Palace of Disciples Commissioner Qi, Grand Commissioner Guo, and Vice Commissioner Jia were all enfeoffed as Ladies of their native counties; Chief Palace Officer of the empress dowager's palace Madame He of Chenliu Commandery was advanced to Madame of Zheng; Madame Yuan of Henan Commandery was advanced to Madame of Qi; Guest Reception Envoy Madame Shi was enfeoffed Madame of Wuwei Commandery; Spring Palace ladies Yao, Chang, Jiao, Wang, Tao, Wei, and Zhao — seven in all — were exceptionally enfeoffed as Commandery Madames; Graceful Beauty Madame Zhao of the Baosheng Palace was enfeoffed Madame of Tianshui Commandery; Wu and eleven below were all appointed to the Spring Palace — by edict of the eleventh month of Tianfu 8.
units.literal: Former Left Imperial Rectifier, Madame Wu of Qi, was advanced to Madame of Yan; Secretariat Madame Cui of Wei was advanced to Madame of Liang; Former Right Imperial Rectifier, Madame Zhao of Tianshui Commandery, was enfeoffed Madame of Wei; Registrar Madame Meng was enfeoffed Madame of Qian; Former Registrar Madame Li was enfeoffed Madame of Longxi Commandery; Palace of Disciples Commissioner Qi, Grand Commissioner Guo, and Vice Commissioner Jia were all enfeoffed as Ladies of their native counties; Chief Palace Officer of the empress dowager's palace, Madame He of Chenliu Commandery, was advanced to Madame of Zheng; Madame Yuan of Henan Commandery was advanced to Madame of Qi; Guest Reception Envoy Madame Shi was enfeoffed Madame of Wuwei Commandery; the Spring Palace ladies Yao, Chang, Jiao, Wang, Tao, Wei, and Zhao — seven persons — were all exceptionally enfeoffed as Commandery Madames; Graceful Beauty Madame Zhao of the Baosheng Palace was enfeoffed Madame of Tianshui Commandery; Wu and eleven below were all appointed to the Spring Palace — edict of the eleventh month of Tianfu 8.

units.zh: 清河郡夫人張氏、彭城郡夫人劉氏並充太后宮司寶，南陽郡夫人路氏、出使夫人趙氏白氏並充皇后宮司賓，開運二年八月敕。
units.en: Lady Zhang of Qinghe Commandery and Lady Liu of Pengcheng Commandery were appointed keepers of the treasury in the empress dowager's palace; Lady Lu of Nanyang Commandery and Envoy Ladies Zhao and Bai were appointed reception keepers in the empress's palace — by edict of the eighth month of the second year of Kaiyun.
units.literal: Madame Zhang of Qinghe Commandery and Madame Liu of Pengcheng Commandery were both appointed keepers of the treasury in the empress dowager's palace; Madame Lu of Nanyang Commandery and Envoy Ladies Zhao and Bai were both appointed reception keepers in the empress's palace — edict of the eighth month of the second year of Kaiyun.

units.zh: 又，按《薛史》不載外戚傳，據《五代會要》云：晉高祖長女長安公主降楊承祚，天福二年五月封，至六年五月卒，追封秦國公主，至七年九月，又追封梁國長公主。
units.en: Also, examining Xue's History, it includes no biography of maternal relatives; according to the Five Dynasties Essentials, Gaozu's eldest daughter, Princess of Chang'an, was married to Yang Chengzuo; she was enfeoffed in the fifth month of Tianfu 2, died in the fifth month of the sixth year, was posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Qin, and in the ninth month of the seventh year was again posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Liang.
units.literal: Also, examining the 《History of Xue》, it does not include a biography of maternal relatives; according to the 《Five Dynasties Essentials》, it says: Gaozu's eldest daughter, Princess of Chang'an, was married to Yang Chengzuo; enfeoffed in the fifth month of Tianfu 2; died in the fifth month of the sixth year; posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Qin; by the ninth month of the seventh year, again posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Liang.

units.zh: 從長女高平縣主、第二女新平縣主、第三女千乘縣主、孫女永慶縣主，並天福七年五月封。）〉
units.en: The eldest daughter of the secondary wife was enfeoffed Lady of Gaoping County; the second daughter, Lady of Xinping County; the third daughter, Lady of Qiansheng County; and the granddaughters, Ladies of Yongqing County — all in the fifth month of Tianfu 7.)〉
units.literal: Eldest daughter of the secondary wife, Lady of Gaoping County; second daughter, Lady of Xinping County; third daughter, Lady of Qiansheng County; granddaughters, Ladies of Yongqing County — all enfeoffed in the fifth month of Tianfu 7.)〉

candidatePacket.instructions: Review dates, event ownership, conversions, endpoint evidence, age reckoning, omitted life dates, and active-date hints. Read all Chinese units for omissions; English is not independent evidence. Do not re-extract names or mentions. For each item identify whose event is dated and justify each endpoint. Same mother does not imply same birth year. Later allusions are not personal activity. Research or record a blocker rather than invent precision. A report cannot approve with missing checks or unresolved research.

findings.problem: The extraction transfers dates from a child’s appointment, a spouse’s investiture narrative, or an unrelated relative’s status to people whose cited Chinese gives only kinship, prior history, or an undated statement.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported dated attestations and active-date entries; retain only source-backed relationships or undated claims, and do not replace them with guessed chronology.

findings.problem: A posthumous investiture or later title is being counted as the deceased woman’s active personal chronology, contrary to the source’s explicit 故 and 追冊 wording.
findings.action: Keep the death information, represent the dated title action as a posthumous reception event where appropriate, and remove the later reception years from active-date hints.
